chapter: Left out of the jazz books; Tatum, Handy and family
title: Mildred Bailey at the Blackhawk: recording with Roy's band
summary: Collins jokes about chewing a guitar, then recalls Mildred Bailey recording in Chicago with Roy's band and Herbie Haymer while she worked at the Blackhawk.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Oh, I'm sure you are. You are documented on record labels in the record. No where else.

Yeah. But I am just amazed, you know, that so little is written about me. You know, because all of the things that I have done and all the things that I am doing, it's -- maybe I'll have to go out and chew up a guitar. I know, I'll just chew it instead of playing it.
No, don't mess with your axe. (inaudible)
Pull a Roland Kirk (inaudible) and break a chair.

I'll do that. But any way at this time when I was with Art, and Scoops Carrier was in the band, and Scoops as I told you was a tremendous saxophonist. Everybody came in. And Mildred Bailey and Red Norva used to come in every night. They were working at the Black hawk. So Art left and then we stayed on with Roy Eldridge, and she just loved Little Jazz. We called her Bailes. She'd come in every night. But I don't know, I'm thinking now. We recorded -- we did some beautiful things with her. We recorded with Mildred in Chicago at this time while they were at the Black hawk. That's a matter of record also.

Herbie Haymer was the only one she used out of her band. She used Roy's band and Herbie Haymer. Now, I think at this time Dave Barber was playing guitar with her, in her band. Bill Miller was playing piano, you know, with -- he's
with Sinatra, he's his conductor now. All these people know that I exist.
All three of these people came through Sinatra;
(inaudible) the first time I ever heard Haymer Herbie Hammer, he was playing back with Axel Stordahl.
Oh, Herbie was a good player and a beautiful guy. And --
After (inaudible) he was playing with he left Benny Axel Stordahl for Sinatra. (inaudible) 2

Yeah, yeah. Well, this is -- when I met him he was with Red Norvo Maribel at the Black Hawk in Chicago, and as I say Bill Miller and Herbie Hammer and someone else, I don't know. But any way I recorded with her then, but I don't believe that Scoops did because I think at this time Joe Eldridge had joined Nat -- I mean Roy. So I don't know whether Scoops was -- he might have been there. I know she loved Scoops' playing, but I don't know whether he was still there.
